title: Sati Behula
desc: Savitri, a devoted wife, decides to cure her husband, a person with a disability, through her prayers and with the help of Goddess Manasa.

title: Anyay Atyachar
desc: In a drunken mix-up, Udayan spends the night with his friend's daughter, believing she's his wife. Chaos unfolds as he unknowingly leaves the next morning.

title: Jeevan Yudha
desc: Rohit desperately seeks his father's killer. Clues lead him to his home town where he finds a new police inspector, Ajay, in charge. He soon realises Ajay is none other than Deva, his father's killer.

title: Guru Dakshina
desc: Guru Dakshina explores the bond between student and teacher, a tale of sacrifice, devotion, and values that stand the test of time.

title: Abhimaan
desc: Ashok, a business tycoon, disowns his daughter when she marries against his wishes. However, years later, he seeks the help of his grandson, Aditya, to mend his relationship with his daughter.

title: Mayer Adhikar
desc: Tarulatha Chowdhury runs her business with her manager, Milesh. Joy is the only son of Mrs. Chowdury. Some conspiracy Joy meets with an accident. Asha helps Joy recover and they both fall in love.

title: Inspector Notty K
desc: In order to secure his dream job, Notty K visits Italy to bring back Sameera and reunite her with her family. All goes well until he falls in love with her and faces some strange events.

title: Biye Bibhraat
desc: Singer Shakya agrees to meet a girl for an arranged marriage, but their courtship gets complicated when her ex-lover enters the picture.

title: Swargo Yatra
desc: This film beautifully captures the power of storytelling, following Abhagi, an 'untouchable' woman, as she fights for dignity against the harsh realities of India's caste system.

desc: Baba Ramdev shows how yoga can help you. He explains different yoga poses. These poses can make your life healthier and less stressful. Learn yoga from Baba Ramdev!
